summary: Infisical held TURBO_TEAM=local, exported to every CI job. A bare `turbo run` (the setup action's postinstall generation) lets that env var override turbo.json's remoteCache.teamSlug, so Vercel answered 403 and turbo disabled the remote cache in every job; laptops hid it behind the teamId in the ignored .turbo/config.json. Fixed by deleting the secret and pinning TURBO_TEAM/TURBO_API from turbo.json after secrets are injected; `bun run check:turborepo-remote-caching` fails on the override.
